title: Violet Nyra Cut Sequin Embroidered Cotton Suit Set for Women – Kurta, Pants & Dupatta
color_custom: Violet purple with tonal embroidery, sequins & bandhani print
description:
Made to twirl. This violet Nyra cut suit gathers into a soft A-line flare beneath a tonal embroidered yoke that sparkles with tiny sequins. Bandhani-style print panels add a playful Rajasthani touch – perfect for Diwali, Navratri and every celebration in between.

✦ The Details
• Nyra cut kurta – fitted yoke gathered into a flowy A-line
• Tonal thread embroidery with sequin work on the yoke
• Bandhani-style print panels on the sides and hem
• Notched round neck and 3/4 sleeves
• Matching straight pants and soft cotton dupatta with a printed geometric border
• Calf-length kurta, 3-piece set

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton throughout – light, breathable and comfortable for dancing, long dinners and warm evenings. The sequins are hand-placed on the yoke for a subtle shimmer.

✦ Fit & Size
Flowy fit through the body with a fitted yoke. Choose your bust size. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your measurements and we will stitch it to fit you exactly, free.

✦ How to Style It
Silver jhumkas, open waves and clear heels for a Diwali card party. Juttis and a mirror-work potli for garba. For mehendi, add flowers in your hair and stacks of bangles.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in our own Jaipur unit – we send you photos of your piece being made
• Free custom fit – share your measurements and we stitch it for you
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
set_items: Nyra Cut A-line Kurta (cotton, embroidered yoke with sequins)
care: Dry clean recommended for the first wash, then gentle hand wash in cold water. Do not wring or bleach. Dry in shade and iron on the reverse side, avoiding the embroidery.
